title: Crispy French-Style Pilaf with Russian Twist
description: A flavorful French-inspired pilaf with a crunchy twist from crispy ingredients. Perfect as a side dish or light meal.
instructions: Heat 2 cups of water in a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Add 1 tsp of Russian pilaf spice mix, salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Add 1 cup of uncooked quick rice. Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and cook for 15-20 minutes or until the water is absorbed.
While rice cooks, heat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Add the crushed crisp (from garnish) and cook, stirring frequently, until crispy and golden brown.
Fluff cooked rice with a fork. Stir in crispy bits.
Serve hot, garnished with additional crispy bits if desired.
